description: Update mutable fields on an existing sandbox — its name, tags, idle timeout, or max duration.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Auto-pause after this many idle minutes (cost-safety cap).

max_duration_seconds.description: New hard lifetime cap in seconds (sent as a Duration string, e.g. 3600s).

tags.description: Replacement tag list (send [] to clear all tags).

name: tenki_update_sandbox
